description: This line plot illustrates the Accuracy@1 (%) for two large language models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, as a function of the number of child nodes, also referred to as tree width, ranging from 1 to 7. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)", uses a linear scale with integer tick marks at 1, 3, 5, and 7. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick marks at 20, 25, 30, and 35. The GPT-4o model is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at 24.4% accuracy at 1 child node, rising to 28.9% at 3 child nodes, peaking at 34.4% at 5 child nodes, and then declining to 31.1% at 7 child nodes. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet model is represented by a dashed purple line with star markers, starting at 26.7% accuracy at 1 child node, rising to 27.8% at 3 child nodes, then steadily declining to 24.4% at 5 child nodes and further to 20.0% at 7 child nodes.
